text:
maya: Heads-up — noticed a bunch of 'zombie' SSE sessions after the route swap around 14:12 UTC. Clients keep reconnecting and tokens keep getting charged even though the console shows sessions closed. :eyes:
chris: Can you paste any proxy/client logs or session ids?
maya: session_id=svc-7b2f4, lease=expired but client still sending resume=1 and getting 200 chunked streaming back.
dalia: I saw similar traces — proxy returned 409 on lease claim then never set a tombstone, leaving an orphan mapping in kvcache.
dalia: log excerpt:
```
proxy: lease_claim failed for svc-7b2f4: 409 CONFLICT
proxy: session_tombstone not set for svc-7b2f4
client: resume_token svc-7b2f4 attempt=3
```
tyler: We started rolling the 'circuit-snap' route ordering change yesterday; that alters the sequence of route swap vs tombstone write. Could be a race.
maya: Console metric mismatch: active_sessions=0 but billing tokens increment for tenant-id=acct-981.
sre-bot: Incident created INC-2026-4421 — streaming session orphaning. Pager on-call: chris, dalia.
chris: For a short mitigation we can flip `tombstone_force_expire=true` on the proxy to aggressively expire ambiguous sessions (will force some client reconns).
dalia: Suggest safer first step: lower tombstone TTL to 30s in the proxy config, watch for reduction in orphaned hits.
tyler: Also add an aggregation metric `sse_orphaned_session_count` and alert if >5/min per region.
maya: I'll push a canary config to eu-west-1 at 10% and monitor `sse_conn_retries` + billing spikes.
maya: Note: clients with resume_window < 60s look like they trigger the worst loop.
chris: Long-term: make lease-renegotiate path idempotent and make route-swap wait for tombstone-ack before flipping routing.
console-bot: Dashboard: https://console.internal/redwood/alerts/INC-2026-4421 (added orphaned_sessions chart to the incident)
maya: Thanks — canary started, watching metrics. :thumbsup:
